name: Doodle Climb
description: Climb a tower of moving platforms: ice ones slide under your feet. A Phaser 2 game (a Doodle Jump take) from the Phaser examples gallery.
goal: Doodle Climb. Use the arrow keys: Left and Right to move, Up to jump (only while standing). Jump from platform to platform to climb to the top of the tower. The platforms move sideways; the icy ones carry you with them less. Falling costs the height you had climbed.

score.expression: (() => { const g = game.state.states.Game; if (!g || !g.player) { return { over: false, score: 0 }; } const m = window.__ibgamerClimb || (window.__ibgamerClimb = { top: g.player.y }); m.top = Math.min(m.top, g.player.y); const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round((1952 - m.top) / 18.88))); return { over: pct >= 100, score: pct, height: Math.round(1952 - g.player.y) }; })()
score.label: % of the tower climbed
